XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Instrument panel malfunction, display remains black
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 61613 | ELECTRONICS | INSTRUMENTATION | VIDEO | SCREEN | BRIGHTNESS | DOES NOT TURN ON | DOES NOT START | OFF | DEACTIVATED | DOES NOT RESPOND | RESPONSE | DASHBOARD | COMPUTER | BOARD |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured between 01/01/21 and 31/12/25 and equipped with a 10" instrument panel (MET05)

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Instrument panel control unit

  • Fault: Instrument panel malfunction, display remains black and unresponsive

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Instrument panel control unit software error

• Action: Initialise the instrument panel control unit; replace the instrument panel if necessary.

  • Procedure: Connect a battery charger to the 12V battery terminals.
    Use diagnostics to initialise the instrument panel control unit.
    If the initialisation procedure does not resolve the issue, replace the instrument panel.


  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, also verify that all related systems are functioning properly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
